name: Cancel a subscription
description: Customer cancels mid-period. The first try goes unanswered and changes nothing; the retry succeeds, billing stops, access stays and the cancellation is confirmed; a second cancel is harmless; the paid period ends and access stops; a refund for the unused time is refused.

steps.note: the provider does not answer the first try
same step as the cancel: access stays until the period ends
same step as the cancel: the customer is told by email or in-app
refused: no refund for the unused part of the period
